subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session-catalog providers gain an additive `createSession` capability that opens the core new-session flow with a provider-selected model?
rationale: This establishes a new plugin and native protocol contract and lets a provider influence model selection in a core session-creation flow; code review cannot choose that permanent ownership and compatibility direction without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow capability
options.body: Keep the additive capability, but first rebuild the PR to the intended catalog, Anthropic, protocol, UI, and focused-test surfaces and document its compatibility semantics.

options.title: Keep creation core-owned
options.body: Drop the provider capability and retain only agent-row creation, hierarchy, and deduplication while core UI decides all model selection.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the feature portion until the session-catalog API direction has a separately approved design.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow capability
recommendation.body: Keep the additive capability, but first rebuild the PR to the intended catalog, Anthropic, protocol, UI, and focused-test surfaces and document its compatibility semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository member implementing the feature and can present or narrow the intended contract for the reviewing owners.
